output.reason: [ev-94989021db77] says the Argo CD 3.0 manifest ships a default resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates configuration for "common resources" and that Argo CD "will always ignore the .status changes", which affects every installation upgrading from v2. The evidence never names ConfigMap, Endpoints or an `.all` key, so the proposed exposure and overlap conditions rest on key names the evidence doesn't support, and they narrow exposure to specific keys. The evidence also doesn't say which keys hold the defaults or what an override has to contain to keep v2 behaviour. So the supported exposure is any environment upgrading from a version below 3.0.0, with no overlap condition.

correction.statement: Every Argo CD environment upgrading from a version below 3.0.0 gets the new default resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates configuration in argocd-cm, and Argo CD always ignores .status changes on watched resources. Operators who want v2 behaviour can override or remove the defaults.
